brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Four hex bases: full bases at (0,0), (0,1), (1,0) and a north half-base at (0,-1) carrying one south-cut drawer (drawer:0#0,-1#cut). Drawer test passes.

requirements.requirement: A spike sits at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 sits at the junction where bases (0,0), (0,1) and (1,0) meet.

requirements.requirement: The spike holds a small platform on it (spike platform accessory)
requirements.evidence: setSpikeAccessory platform-sm on the mount spike; BOM line spike-acc-platform-sm (Platform, small) qty 1. A plain solid spike refused the platform, so the mount type was used.

requirements.requirement: Keep the unit compact (modest part count)
requirements.evidence: 8 parts-list nodes total (4 bases, 1 drawer, 1 spike, 2 joint bolts), under the 14 limit; check_build is clean with meshClash clear and no LOOSE_BODY warnings.

finish.summary: Built a compact desk unit: three full hex bases in a triangle plus a north half-base carrying a south drawer, a mount spike at the three-base corner, and a small platform on the spike. Two joint bolts lock the bases. check_build reports meshClash clear and only an informational cap-face note. Printed material and strength are not verified by the configurator.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
